items.headline: Pakistan ke pehle astronaut Tiangong pahunche
items.detail: Pakistan ke Muhammad Zeeshan Ali Shenzhou-24 mission ke saath China ke Tiangong space station par pahunchne wale pehle videshi astronaut bane.
items.exam_angle: China-Pakistan space sahyog, Tiangong — UPSC IR

items.headline: Cairo me tanker aag, 31 ki maut
items.detail: Cairo ki ring road par petrol tanker palatne se lagi aag me kam se kam 31 log mare gaye aur 21 ghayal hue, Egypt ke swasthya mantralaya ne bataya.
items.exam_angle: Egypt me badi sadak durghatna — UPSC IR

items.headline: Huawei ko America me doshi thahraya gaya
items.detail: Brooklyn court ki jury ne Huawei ko vyapar rahasya chori ki sajish aur bank dhokhadhadi samet 12 me se 10 aaropon me doshi thahraya, saza September 2027 me hogi.
items.exam_angle: America-China tech yuddh, pratibandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: China: Shanghai neta Chen Jining par jaanch
items.detail: China ne Shanghai ke party pramukh aur Politburo sadasya Chen Jining ke khilaf bhrashtachar ki jaanch shuru ki, do saal me giraye gaye chaunthe Politburo sadasya bane.
items.exam_angle: China ki rajneeti, bhrashtachar abhiyan — UPSC IR

items.headline: America ne nagrikon ko Iran chhodne ko kaha
items.detail: America ke Virtual Embassy ne nagrikon se turant Iran chhodne ko kaha, kyunki Iran aur Houthi ke hamlo ke baad ladai tezi se badhne ka khatra hai.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanav, travel advisory — UPSC IR

items.headline: Houthi ka Saudi ki sabse badi refinery par hamla
items.detail: Houthi ne Saudi Arabia ki sabse badi Ras Tanura refinery par hamle ka dava kiya; satellite tasveeron me dhuaan dikha aur tel ke daam 3.5% chadh gaye.
items.exam_angle: Khadi me tel suraksha, Houthi sangharsh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Solomon Islands ne Australia se suraksha sandhi ki
items.detail: Solomon Islands aur Australia ne sandhi par hastakshar kiye; Australia ab uska mukhya suraksha saathi hoga aur wahan koi videshi sainya adda nahi banega.
items.exam_angle: Prashant me China ka prabhav, suraksha sandhi — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kim ne tactical parmanu hathiyar badhane ko kaha
items.detail: Kim Jong Un ne parmanu samagri aur hathiyar suvidhaon ke nirikshan ke dauran kaha — tactical parmanu hathiyaron ko kai kshetron me tainat kiya jaye aur parmanu samagri utpadan badhaya ja raha hai; KCNA ke mutabik unhone North Korea ki parmanu shakti ko 'bilkul atoot' bataya.
items.exam_angle: North Korea parmanu karyakram, Korea praaydweep suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Cairo me tanker aag, 31 log mare
items.detail: Cairo ke paas Giza ki Ring Road par petroleum tanker palatne se lagi aag me kam se kam 31 log mare aur 21 ghayal hue; aag me 27 gaadiyan jal gayi, jaanch jaari hai.

items.headline: North Korea ne Swiss daftar band karwaya
items.detail: North Korea ne Pyongyang me Switzerland ka naya rajnaitik daftar band karne ko kaha aur uske pramukh ko 48 ghante me desh chhodne ka aadesh diya — Switzerland ne ek bachchon ke shivir par pratibandh lagaye the.
items.exam_angle: North Korea-Switzerland sambandh, pratibandh kootneeti — UPSC IR

items.headline: Pakistani astronaut pehli baar Tiangong station par
items.detail: Pakistan ke Muhammad Zeeshan Ali Shenzhou-24 se China ke Tiangong station par pahunchne wale pehle videshi astronaut bane; Tang Hongbo aur Wu Yi ke saath woh lagbhag ek hafta prayog karenge.
items.exam_angle: China-Pakistan antariksh sahyog, Tiangong station — UPSC S&T/IR
items.image_credit: China News Service, CC BY 4.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Murmansk governor bhrashtachar me hirasat me
items.detail: Russia ke Murmansk kshetra ke governor Andrei Chibis ko bade bhrashtachar jaanch me Moscow court ne do mahine ki hirasat me bheja; woh Ukraine yuddh shuru hone ke baad giraftar hone wale pehle sewarat governor hain.
items.exam_angle: Russia Arctic, Northern Sea Route, Murmansk — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: Presidential Executive Office of Russia, CC BY 4.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Ramaphosa ko Farmgate jaanch se rahat
items.detail: South Africa ki Western Cape High Court ne 2022 ki Section 89 panel report ko 'gair-kanuni' batakar radd kar diya; Phala Phala farm chori par Rashtrapati Cyril Ramaphosa ke khilaf mahabhiyog jaanch khatm ho gayi.
items.exam_angle: South Africa, Phala Phala, mahabhiyog — UPSC IR/Polity

items.headline: Bangladesh: garment mazdoori 36% badhi
items.detail: Bangladesh ne garment mazdooron ki nyuntam mazdoori 36% badhakar 17,000 taka kar di; hafton ke virodh ke baad wage board ne 4-2 vote se faisla kiya, nayi dar 1 December se lagu hogi.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh RMG, shram, niryaat — UPSC Economy/IR

items.headline: Russia se riot gas rokne ki maang
items.detail: 34 deshon aur EU ne Russia se Ukraine yuddh me riot-control gas ka istemal turant rokne ko kaha; OPCW ki lab ne khaai me mile namoonon me CS gas ki pushti ki, Ukraine ne 2022 se 14,000 se zyada aise mamle darj kiye hain.
items.exam_angle: OPCW, Chemical Weapons Convention, CS gas — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: CEphoto, Uwe Aranas, CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Ukraine ko $622m ke F-16 upkaran
items.detail: America ne Ukraine ke F-16 ladaku vimanon ke liye $622 million ke rakh-rakhav upkaranon ki bikri ko manzoori di; kharcha Belgium, Denmark, Netherlands aur Norway uthayenge, America ka koi paisa nahi lagega.
items.exam_angle: F-16, JUMPSTART, NATO sahyog — UPSC IR/Defence
items.image_credit: Staff Sgt. Cherie A. Thurlby, US Air Force, Public domain (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Kyiv mall par ballistic missile hamla
items.detail: Russia ne der raat Kyiv par ballistic missile hamla kiya; Desnianskyi jile me ek shopping mall aur do aur imaratein nishana bani, kam se kam 4 log ghayal hue, jinme se 2 ki haalat gambhir hai.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh, ballistic missile — UPSC IR

items.headline: Lebanon ka doosra airport December me
items.detail: Lebanon ka doosra antarrashtriya airport — uttar me Qlayaat (Rene Mouawad) — 14 December se vyavsayik udanein shuru karega; Hezbollah ke kamzor prabhav ke baad khula ye airport pehle Turkey, Egypt aur Jordan ki udanein dega.
items.exam_angle: Lebanon, Hezbollah, West Asia — UPSC IR

items.headline: Riyadh tower par Houthi drone hamla
items.detail: Houthi drone ne Riyadh ke financial district ki ek tower par hamla kiya; 11 log ghayal hue, jinme 2 Bharatiya bhi hain; Bharat ne hamle ki kadi ninda ki.
items.exam_angle: Houthi, Saudi Arabia, West Asia — UPSC IR

items.headline: Trump ka birthright citizenship order roka
items.detail: America ke doosre judge ne bhi Trump ke birthright citizenship seemit karne wale aadesh par rok lagayi; ab prashasan ko dono faislon ko palatna hoga.
items.exam_angle: US 14th Amendment, birthright citizenship — UPSC Polity/IR

items.headline: Ukraine ne Savasleyka hawai-adda par hamla kiya
items.detail: Ukraine ne Russia ke Savasleyka hawai-adde par hamla kiya, jahan Kinzhal missile le jaane wale MiG-31K viman tainat hain; hamle me 3 MiG-31 aur 2 Su-34 viman kshatigrast hue.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, Kinzhal missile

items.headline: Macy's ki 100vi Thanksgiving parade tali
items.detail: Toofan ke kaaran New York ki 100 saal purani parade pehli baar tal gayi; ab Shanivaar 28 November subah 8:30 baje hogi.

items.headline: Bangladesh me 27-28 November ko deshvyapi band
items.detail: Pratibandhit Awami League ne 8 maangon ke saath band ka elaan kiya; Hasina 16 December ko lautne ki baat kar rahi hain, Dhaka ne giraftari ki chetavni di hai.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh ki rajneeti aur Bharat-Bangladesh sambandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Turkey me mahila hinsa ke khilaf hazaaron utre
items.detail: 25 November ko Istanbul me lagbhag 3,000 aur Ankara me 1,000 logon ne mahilaon ke khilaf hinsa ke khilaf pradarshan kiya, Taksim par pratibandh ke bawjood.
items.exam_angle: 25 November — Mahila Hinsa Unmoolan ke liye Antarrashtriya Diwas

items.headline: Ukraine ne Russia ke airbase par hamla kiya
items.detail: Ukraine ne Nizhny Novgorod ke Savasleyka airbase par hamla kar paanch vimaan ko nuksan pahunchaya — teen MiG-31 aur do Su-34; Ukraine ke General Staff ke mutabik hamla Budhvar ko hua.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, deep strike — UPSC IR

items.headline: Netanyahu ke khilaf bhrashtachar case kamzor
items.detail: Jerusalem District Court ke judge ne kaha Case 4000 me Netanyahu ko doshi thahrana mushkil hai aur abhiyojan ko case wapas lene par vichar karna chahiye; Case 2000 par bhi punarvichar ki sifarish ki — ye faisla nahi, sifarish hai.
items.exam_angle: Israel ki rajneeti, Netanyahu mukadma — UPSC IR

items.headline: Cartagena me sabhi 20 bandhak bachaye gaye
items.detail: Colombia ke Cartagena me Exito supermarket me 17 ghante ki gherabandi ke baad suraksha balon ne sabhi 20 bandhakon ko bacha liya; ek hamlaawar mara gaya. Hamlaawaron ne bakhtarband gaadi lootne ki nakamyab koshish ke baad dukaan me sharan li thi.

items.headline: Abrego Garcia America se Spain pahunche
items.detail: Kilmar Abrego Garcia, jise Trump prashasan ne galti se El Salvador bhej diya tha, sweccha se America chhodkar Madrid pahunche; unhone kaha is baar ve aazadi ke saath ja rahe hain.
items.exam_angle: America ki immigration neeti — UPSC IR

items.headline: Dubai ke paas tanker ke kareeb dhamaka
items.detail: UKMTO ne bataya, Dubai se 50 nautical miles paschim me tanker ke paas ek agyaat projectile se dhamaka hua; tanker ko koi nuksan nahi, sabhi crew surakshit hain.
items.exam_angle: Gulf me samudri suraksha, UKMTO — UPSC IR

items.headline: Indonesia ki khadan me 13 ki maut
items.detail: Paschim Java ke Bogor me baarish se bhari ek avaidh sone ki khadan me 13 mazdoor mare gaye, 13 ab bhi 100 meter neeche fanse hain; bachav kaam jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Avaidh khanan aur aapda prabandhan — UPSC

items.headline: SpaceX ko 10 lakh upgrah ki manzoori
items.detail: America ke FCC ne SpaceX ke 'Starmind' project ko antariksh me AI data centre ke liye 10 lakh upgrah bhejne ki manzoori di; pehla upgrah 2033 tak bhejna hoga.
items.exam_angle: Antariksh me AI data centre, FCC — UPSC S&T

items.headline: America: Bharat par 25% tariff ka prastav
items.detail: USTR ne Bharat se aane wale saaman par 25% tariff ka prastav rakha; yadi Bharat-America vyapar samjhota ho jaye to ye dar 17% tak seemit rahegi.
items.exam_angle: Section 301, Bharat-America vyapar — UPSC IR/Economy

items.headline: Islamabad me Makkah raksha samjhota baithak
items.detail: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia aur Türkiye ke mantri Islamabad me Makkah raksha samjhote ko vyavharik roop dene par do din ki baithak karenge.
items.exam_angle: Makkah raksha samjhota, samuhik suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Gaza me Hamas suraksha pramukh mare gaye
items.detail: Israel ke hawai hamle me Hamas ke uttari Gaza suraksha pramukh Mohammed Abu al-Ouf, unki patni aur do betiyan mare gaye; do din me mare gaye doosre varishth adhikari hain.
items.exam_angle: Gaza, Hamas, Israel — UPSC IR

items.headline: Sudan me drone hamle, 19 nagrik mare
items.detail: Sudan ke Blue Nile rajya me RSF ke drone hamlo me kam se kam 19 nagrik mare gaye aur 20 se zyada ghayal hue, adhikar samuh Emergency Lawyers ne bataya.
items.exam_angle: Sudan grih yuddh, RSF drone yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Hormuz me LNG tanker par mine hamla
items.detail: Iran ke Revolutionary Guards ke mutabik, Hormuz Strait me ek LNG tanker samudri mine se takrakar aag me jal utha; usi din do tel tanker bhi mine ki chapat me aaye.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz Strait, tel vyapar, Iran — UPSC IR

items.headline: Har American bachche ko do SpaceX share
items.detail: Elon Musk ne kaha, America ke har bachche ko SpaceX ke do share milenge — ek company se, ek unki taraf se; kul keemat lagbhag 18 arab dollar.
items.exam_angle: Trump Account, SpaceX, AI boom — UPSC Economy

items.headline: Houthi ka Saudi bandargahon par hamla
items.detail: Houthi ne Saudi Arabia ke Jizan bandargah par hamla kiya aur Jeddah ki taraf drone bheja; Saudi suraksha balon ne Riyadh ki taraf aati do ballistic missile aur Jeddah ke paas drone ko roka.
items.exam_angle: Lal Sagar, Houthi-Saudi sangharsh, samudri suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Russia ke hamle se Ukraine me 5 ki maut
items.detail: Russia ke raat bhar ke hamlo me Ukraine me kam se kam 5 log mare gaye aur paanch kshetron me bijli gul ho gayi; Odesa me 2 mare aur Kyiv me ek apartment building me aag lag gayi.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, urja buniyadi dhancha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kroger 3,000 corporate naukri khatm karega
items.detail: America ki sabse badi traditional grocery chain Kroger ne corporate chhantni shuru kar di hai; teen saal me lagbhag 3,000 naukriyan khatm hongi, jabki Bengaluru me naya Capability Center khul raha hai.
items.exam_angle: US job market, offshoring, Bharat me GCC — UPSC economy

items.headline: Congo me Ebola ke 12,000 se zyada case
items.detail: Congo me Ebola ke confirmed case 12,021 ho gaye hain aur 5,904 logon ki maut hui hai; ladai ke karan roktham ka kaam mushkil ho raha hai, sarkari data ne bataya.
items.exam_angle: Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, WHO — UPSC health

items.headline: UK ne 1 lakh purv sainikon ko patra likha
items.detail: Britain ne Cold War ke baad pehli baar lagbhag 1 lakh purv sainikon ko patra likhkar unke sampark, naukri aur kaushal ki jankari mangi hai, taaki Strategic Reserve taiyar rahe.
items.exam_angle: UK Strategic Reserve, NATO, Europe suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: OPEC ne COP31 haar ka dosh EU par dala
items.detail: OPEC pramukh Haitham Al Ghais ne kaha tel utpadak deshon ne COP31 me 'good faith' se hissa liya aur Antalya vartao ke bhang hone ke liye EU zimmedar hai.
items.exam_angle: COP31, jalvayu vartao, OPEC — UPSC environment

items.headline: America me toofan se 3.5 lakh ghar bijli-vihin
items.detail: Thanksgiving par America bhar me toofan aur barfbari se 3.5 lakh se zyada gharon ki bijli chali gayi; sabse zyada asar Missouri aur Virginia me raha, PowerOutage.us ke anusar.

items.headline: Russia-Ukraine ka sabse bada kaidi adla-badli jald
items.detail: America ke vishesh doot Jared Kushner ne kaha ki Russia aur Ukraine ke beech yuddh ka sabse bada kaidi adla-badli Christmas se pehle hoga; hazaron log apne parivaron ke paas lautenge.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, kaidi adla-badli, Abu Dhabi vartalap — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: US Mission to the European Union, Wikimedia Commons (Public domain)

items.headline: North Korea ne Swiss doot ko nikala
items.detail: North Korea ne Pyongyang sthit Switzerland ke rajnaitik karyalaya ko band karne aur uske pramukh Sylvain Astier ko 48 ghante me desh chhodne ka aadesh diya; wajah Switzerland ka ek bachchon ke shivir par pratibandh hai.
items.exam_angle: North Korea, Switzerland, pratibandh, Ukraine ke bachche — UPSC IR

items.headline: EU neta saat saal ke budget par bante
items.detail: Brussels me EU ke 27 neta 2028–2034 ke lagbhag 1.6 lakh crore euro ke budget aur Ukraine ke liye 45 arab euro ke naye karz par bante hue hain; samjhota December me hone ki ummeed hai.
items.exam_angle: EU budget, MFF, Ukraine vitt — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kremlin ka Ukraine par yuddh badhane ka aarop
items.detail: Kremlin pravakta Dmitry Peskov ne kaha Ukraine yuddh ko Mediterranean aur Baltic sagar tak badha raha hai; ye bayan America aur NATO pramukh ki sanyukt chetavni ke baad aaya.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, NATO — UPSC IR

items.headline: UK net migration 1997 ke baad sabse kam
items.detail: ONS ke mutabik June 2026 tak ke saal me UK ki net migration 77,000 rahi, 1997 ke baad sabse kam; pichhle saal ye 204,000 thi.
items.exam_angle: UK pravasan, ONS aankde — UPSC IR

items.headline: Zaporizhzhia me drone hamla, 5 ki maut
items.detail: Russia-niyukt Zaporizhzhia governor Yevgeny Balitsky ke mutabik Ukraine ke drone ne Vesioloye me parking par hamla kiya, 5 log mare aur 3 ghayal hue.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Iran ka prastav: Hormuz 48 ghante me khulega
items.detail: Tehran ne Qatar ke madhyam se America ko prastav bheja — nausainik nakabandi hate aur har morche par ladai ruke to Hormuz Strait 48 ghante ke andar phir se khul jayega.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz Strait, Iran-America tanav — UPSC IR
